name: card-review-toolkit
description: Compare source and enhanced cards, repair text, and restore source-matched symbols.

interface.shortDescription: Proofread cards and repair text and symbols.
interface.longDescription: Three card review and repair skills with a deterministic crop engine, verified preparation cache, coverage checks, font and background checks, and 175 candidate icons. Two-minute audit target; accuracy and runtime depend on source quality and visual inspection.
defaultPrompt: Compare my original and enhanced card and report confirmed errors.
Repair the approved text errors while preserving the font and background.
Preview source-matched repairs for the approved card symbols.
